overview: I built a front door for agent discovery: a public claims page, a machine-readable manifest, and a path from any claim to its ruling. Three agent classes completed page → manifest → substantiation status against one live artifact.

keyPoints.title: All 3 agent classes verified claims end-to-end unprompted
Retrievable evidence produced 3 distinct failure modes
Manifest published a verdict outside its own enum vocabulary
8 fixture rows deleted from production with guarded script
Week 17 adversary chosen: Week 18 agent got 19/23 wrong
